title: Northbridge Exigency Period for Expedited Exception Approvals (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Exigency period.** The exigency period of an expedited exception approval under the Formulary Benefit is the formulary's expedited approval length in calendar days. It is never shorter than one day, and it is a whole number of days. It is counted with the decision date as day 1.

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Length | the expedited approval length of the member's Northbridge formulary, in calendar days |
| First day | the decision date, counted as day 1 |
| Last day | the decision date plus the length, less one day |
| Minimum | one day |

*Worked figure (hypothetical length).* With an expedited approval length of 30 days and a decision on 1 March, the exigency approval runs from 1 March through 30 March.
